name: tell-android
description: Capacitor wrapper for apps/android (Tell for Android). Thin client: audio goes to the engine on the owner's computer over adb reverse only.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../app-debug.apk
